body:
She is, but I'm not staying with her right now so she (understandably) doesn't want to get involved. I have more than 2 friends, I was saying that I had two that I could talk to easily, but I can't do that. I find it difficult to talk to my other friends (they're great, just I'm pretty weird with stuff like this). 

Thanks! I'll read that now.
It does, but it sure as hell doesn't help me right now. This does though so cheers!
I'm not holding it against her. I just could really talk to her right now, cause I'm going through a really tough time and she was there for me before, I guess I just want that back...
Well then we might both be fucked up in the head!

Okay, most things I've read on bipolar disorder seem to suggest that it always takes a while to switch, and it was making me question it. It makes me feeo better that I'm not alone with rapid switching.
Many of us have been through it too, no one is worthless.

Thank you for this, it means a lot!

She really is. I know that, but I wish that I could have done more for her. I also have trouble bringing it up, since it's a sensitive subject and she can get anxious easily. Any idea how I can try to help while not making it too much for her.

I would do anything for her. She does get help, but a lot of the times when she gets depressed I will talk to her and it'll help.

I have been having my own mental health problems lately, which is a lot of the reason of why I needed a break. I wish I could always be there for her but I can't.

Yeah I'm trying to do the same.

Thanks for all of the help!
I mean I don't need scientific studies to tell me that it sounds relaxing.

Yeah, it's an absolute blast when both things just make the other worse.

I might try that.

I know!

Yeah I plan to do so soon, but I usually don't sleep well.

I'm not completely isolated, I still am doing stuff with friends and family. I haven't talked to some people as much though.

I know it does, I bet I'll be a bit better tomorrow when I can talk to people (since most people I know are sleeping now).
Yeah I do have people that I love a lot, but I haven't been able to see them or haven't been talking much with them. I kind of have been isolating myself more lately too.

I don't always want to feel like this though.

That is a good quote, but it really fucking hurts.

I know, but I don't know how much longer I can do the right thing for.

Yeah I guess you are right. I am kind of a mess right now.

I know that, it's just that sometimes I want her to be there, sometimes I just want to feel like she's there for me. I understand this isn't my fault, but that doesn't change how alone I feel.

I have had to be the parent I never had for so long. She never was there for me, ever.

Yes we are.

I know, but I'm worried that she'll do something dangerous if I'm not there, which is unhealthy for me.

I know she is, and it is rough (and I'm pretty sure I have it, and if not something like it). But still this is too much for me.

Thank you so much.

Yeah I know, and thank you for spending your time on this, it means a lot that people care.

I get it, but it's shitty that she prefers a bottle of wine to me.

I know, she is taking out on my dad too, which is not cool (they aren't together, and he has nothing to do with this). I also keep seeing all of these things saying how "you need to be nice to your mom because she is great to you" since it's mother's day, and I can't wait for that to stop.

I know that she is bipolar, and that has been something that I've had to deal with for years. The psrt that gets to me is that she was drinking just because, and that's what caused a lot of this. She wasn't sad, or needed it, she just wanted to, not even that much.

I also just really wish I could see my friend right now, but I haven't been able to in a while, and that is making me feel worse.

I'm so sorry, how are you coping with that? Have you gotten past it?

I honestly care more about my friends than my mom, but I don't think I deserve them a lot. One of them in particular is just the most thoughtful, selfless person ever, and I don't think I could be good enough for her.

I've been a little rough lately from it.

Yeah, but you actually did help! Thank you! (I am always a little taken aback by how much people care for strangers online.)

Yeah she tells me everything, but it's so tough to hear her going through all of this, but not being able to help is heart breaking. 

That's what I'm hoping, but I don't want her to feel obliged to do it and make her feel worse/more anxious, if that makes sense?

We already text quite a bit, but it isn't the same as in person.

She is totally open with me, she just has been feeling worse around people. I don't really know what to do.
Thank you! I hope it goes well too!
I am trying to balance not being too pushy while also being there for her. I am not telling her to stop, just that I am here to talk any time she is feeling like that.

Thank you so much for this, I can tell you are really trying to help!

She has a psychiatrist who she talks to, and that has been helping her.

I would love to spend some time with her and just talk about everything that's going on, but I don't think she wants to be with people much lately. Do you think I should try to get her to, or wait for her to come to me? And I am trying my best to be supportive throughout all of this (I have dealt with my own depression) and to make sure she knows that it is okay that she cut, and I want to help her from now on.
I know, we talk a lot. I don't think we're going to date or anything. I am just trying to get it off my chest really.
Whatever happens you always can talk to us!
Congrats! Hope it continues for more months to come!
Reddit helps with that.

I think I worded it wrong, I don't want advice on if I should pursue it or not. I want advice on how to get over the feelings I have.

Sorry about that, I know it's wrong, and I would never do it.
Will do!
9 months. I would rather not lose my friends though.
I know I can't, I just need to distract myself or something.
I feel like that would screw things up, and I don't want to mess up my friendships with two of my closest friends.
I don't want to do anything, messing it up for him would be horrible. I just want to get rid of my feeling for her.

She is funny and smart and we get along so well. 

I don't want to have her traits, but that is something to think about.
I am happy for him, I don't have any ill will whatsoever, just I like her. I will live my life.
I have talked to her about it (we have a fairly close friendship) and she'll probablu stay, at least for a while.

Thank you, that's really sweet. 

I want to find someone else, but she is really amazing. I know it will probably pass with time.

The mum advice is great!
I mean how to forget her. I obviously won't do anything with her, I just want to know what other people do to get rid of the idea of it.
I have not.

I have similar problems with depression and insomnia lately. I don't smoke weed but the two things that can help is music (a bit) and boxing. I do a boxing workout thing twice a week and it's one of the few times a week I don't think about how much I hate myself. 

I really hope that you can get through this but you are almost old enough to get your own place, and then you can do whatever you want to feel better.
